properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Purview: No Public Access
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Purview accounts with public network access enabled. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7). Purview accounts governing federal data classifications must only be accessible via Private Endpoint — public network access is prohibited to prevent unauthorized metadata exposure and data catalog manipulation.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Purview accounts with public access. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
